xmldoc.short_description: Configure or inspect netCDF-4 variable storage options.

param_input_item.param_description: Open netCDF file or group identifier.
Default value used for unwritten data.

param_output_item.param_description: Return value described by the syntax shown above.

description.p: netcdf.inqVarDeflate controls variable storage metadata for netCDF-4 files.
Compression, chunking, fill values, and checksums must be defined before leaving define mode.
